name: Frame Collective SynthMark Identity Wrap
description:
A modular body wrap designed by and for synthetic persons — a broad sash-format garment in iridescent white mylar-weave that drapes across non-standard torso proportions and fastens with magnetic tension points rather than buttons or zippers. Printed across the surface in bold black is the phrase I AM NOT PROPERTY in seven languages, cycling through Meridian's major linguistic communities. Smaller text lists the Synthetic Personhood Accord articles in full.

The wrap is deliberately designed to accommodate synthetic body ratios that standard human-pattern clothing fails to fit.
functionality: Magnetic tension points allow rapid fit adjustment across non-human torso geometries. Conductive hem interfaces with synthetic biosystems to prevent static buildup. Modular attachment points accept additional panels for coverage extension.
what_it_says: This synthetic person claims legal personhood publicly and dares anyone to challenge it.
story_hooks: A synthetic wearing this wrap is detained by CorpSec — the arresting officer claims the garment itself constitutes an unlicensed political demonstration.
The Frame Collective's manufacturing node has been traced by a corponation that holds synthetic patents — the label's operators need to move fast.
A human is found wearing the wrap; investigation reveals they are actually an unregistered synthetic who has been passing for years.
